motion.name: seal-press
motion.purpose: The one authored moment: seals press in once on scroll; static under reduced motion.

display.purpose: Subject name in the masthead, once per page.

label.purpose: Mono form data: folios, dates, stacks, exhibits.

dos: Do number clauses I–IV and acta folios as tabular data; the sequence is the file's order.
Do expand acta and diploma detail in place with named show/hide controls.
Do caption every shipping raster with its source line.
Do theme browser surfaces from the palette: red text selection, seal focus rings, paper scrollbars, tabular numerals on counts.
donts: Don't put any kicker, eyebrow, or section index above a heading.
Don't open modals, draw glow or gradients, or lift surfaces with shadow.
Don't set headings or decoration in mono, or stand an emoji where an icon belongs.
Don't animate anything except the one seal press; all other state changes swap instantly.
Don't invent testimonials, clients, metrics, or any claim the evidence does not carry.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, ink text, one stamp-red accent; warm ledger grays for the rest.
Ruled rows, 2px ink rules opening each clause, sharp acta corners.
Grotesk headlines with a point of view; mono reserved for form data.
One authored moment: the seal press. Everything else swaps instantly.
narrative.overview: The page is the commissioning dossier of one engineer: background, six sealed delivery records, work history with credentials, and a signature block. Warm paper floods edge to edge; a single utilitarian red appears only where something was received, stamped, or must be signed.

rules.body: Stamp red appears only on seals, primary actions, and proof of received work. Anything else wanting emphasis uses weight or size.
rules.name: The One Red Rule

rules.body: No text ships below 4.5:1 on its ground. Faint Ledger is the lightest ink allowed, and only for data.
rules.name: The 4.5 Rule

rules.body: Clause names are the headings themselves. No eyebrow or kicker label sits above any heading, ever.
rules.name: The Clause Speaks Rule

rules.body: Mono appears on data a file would store. A heading set in mono is a costume change, not a style.
rules.name: The Mono Files Rule

rules.body: No box shadows anywhere on the page.
rules.name: The Flat File Rule
